## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run quality:code`
- [ ] Relevant browser QA completed when UI or capture behavior changed

## Screenshots

Add before-and-after screenshots for visible changes, or write `Not applicable`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Comments are concise, current, and written in English.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, generated build output, or browser artifacts are included.
- [ ] Documentation and both languages were updated when user-facing behavior changed.
